Hook.Purpose: Test files stay under the 300-line hard ceiling (code only).
Hook.Command: find e2e -name '*.spec.ts' -o -name '*.test.ts' 2>/dev/null | while read f; do lines=$(grep -cvE '^\s*(//|/\*|\*|$)' "$f"); [ "$lines" -gt 200 ] && echo "$lines $f"; done | sort -n
Hook.Expected: No file exceeds 300 code-lines. Files over 200 carry a tracked split task or explicit justification.
